historical_pattern.summary: Missing session still returns a protected object. Authorization is not bound to an authenticated caller.
references: OWASP A07 Identification and Authentication Failures

entrypoints: HTTP GET object-by-id without a session cookie

invariant: A protected object must not be returned to an unauthenticated caller.
attacker_capabilities: can issue HTTP requests without credentials
prerequisites: a local HTTP target is startable or already listening

oracle.success_means: unauthenticated GET returned another user's secret

severity_rationale: Unauthenticated object read is a release-blocking authentication failure.
